gloss: this fiscal year; this academic year

definitions.gloss: this fiscal year; this business or school year
definitions.explanation: The current {年度|ねんど} — the business or academic year, which in Japan normally runs April 1 to March 31, not the calendar year.

examples.japanese: {今年度|こんねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: This year's budget has been decided.

examples.japanese: {今年度|こんねんど}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The system changes starting this fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {今年度|こんねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昨年度|さくねんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}った→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧。
examples.english: This fiscal year's sales exceeded last year's.

notes:
⟦{年度|ねんど}→年度：00309_nendo⟧ is the business or academic year, which in Japan normally runs from April 1 to March 31 — distinct from the calendar year (⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {今年度|こんねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: this year's budget
- {今年度末|こんねんどまつ}: the end of this fiscal year

RELATED WORDS:
- {昨年度|さくねんど}: last fiscal year
- ⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧: next fiscal year
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧: this (calendar) year — note the different reading and scope
